items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: owned by Tom and Ben Turpin who I found out (today)-- tremendous people

ctx.x: Now the Grand Central is right up the street from the Booker T. Washington Theater. The Booker T. Washington Theater was run by some fellows by the name of, owned by Tom and Ben Turpin who I found out (today)-- tremendous people ...
Big ragtime piano player, wasn't he?
